items.prompt: waist-up portrait of a single male giant, centered and facing the viewer, wearing silver heraldry, drinking, background: garden, painted fantasy illustration, full bleed, detailed face
items.bio: Sample sips tea from a silver bucket in the garden, minding the snails. Hedges reach the giant's knees and roses the ankles. Bees settle on that wide hat and stay all afternoon.

items.prompt: waist-up portrait of a single non-binary dragon, centered and facing the viewer, wearing obsidian heraldry, weaving, background: none, painted fantasy illustration, full bleed, detailed face
items.bio: For chilly villages, Sample weaves scarves of obsidian thread, warming each stitch with a breath. The dragon's tail keeps the yarn tidy. Nobody has yet dared to ask for socks.
